summary: Zeta Network Group filed a Form 6-K to disclose its corporate governance practices as a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer listing on Nasdaq. The filing clarifies which Nasdaq corporate governance rules it will follow and which it will exempt from under home-country practices, including majority-independent board, compensation and nominating committees, and shareholder vote requirements. A home-country rule exemption letter from legal counsel is attached. This is a routine governance disclosure with no transaction, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event.
